title: Airtable paging fails with LIST_RECORDS_ITERATOR_NOT_AVAILABLE in a slow export loop
symptoms: Export works on small tables and fails partway through large ones
Failure appears when per-page processing is slow
cause: The offset token points at a server-side iterator that can time out from client inactivity or a server restart. Doing heavy work between page requests lets it expire, and iteration then has to restart from the beginning.
fix: Fetch all pages first and process afterward, keep the gap between page requests short, and restart the listing from scratch on this error.
apply:
const all = await base("Big Table").select({ pageSize: 100 }).all(); // fetch first
for (const rec of all) { await process(rec); } // then do slow work
affected: Airtable Web API list records pagination, as of 2026-10
